description: Vina reference: co-crystal ligand redocked into the staged pocket — the binding-affinity floor that any generated molecule must beat to claim a hit (TODO-22 metric #1 denominator).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric reference floor (TODO-22 metric #1)
source: RS1 (sulphone hydroxamate MMP-13 inhibitor) redocked on PDB 830c via VinaDockingAdapter (exhaustiveness=8, n_poses=5); report at molmetal/reports/mmp13_vina_real.md

lit_baseline.vina_mean_lit_MMP13: ~-7.5 to -8.0 kcal/mol for known MMP13 hydroxamate inhibitors in CrossDocked benchmarks (cross-target reference, not pocket-specific)

notes: Reference floor for the high-affinity / triple-threshold / relaxed-success metrics (#3, #4, #5) — a generated molecule is considered a hit iff its top-pose kcal/mol < RS1 (sulphone hydroxamate MMP-13 inhibitor)'s redocked score.

Reference redocked at -1.285 kcal/mol is unusually shallow; this is consistent with the small pocket radius (10.0 A) and the RS1 pose geometry from PDB 830c — the sulphone group is exposed to solvent in the crystal pose and Vina scores it accordingly.
Other pocket references (1h36, test_001..test_019) are NOT computed because the receptors are not staged on disk in this snapshot.
